# 向阳飞船竞速赛 / Sunside Regatta

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`common/missions/missions/02_contracts.txt:3828-3866`; `common/event_chains/00_event_chains_nomads.txt:208`; `common/inline_scripts/contracts/SunTripCruise.txt`; `common/inline_scripts/special_projects/suntrip_cruise_project.txt`; `common/inline_scripts/events/nomads_suntrip_cruise_event.txt`; `events/nomads_events_1.txt:7593-8100`
- DLC：Nomads
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

永恒巡航（origin_forever_cruise）的内部契约，由乘客一侧提出，不能由玩家主动发布（potential_issuer always = no）。每年脉冲 nomads.1300 → nomads.1305：在已发布契约少于3份（偏向某一方时少于5份）且乘客满意度进度不在450–550之间时，从30份巡航契约中等权（各10）抽取，当前不满的一方权重×5（@cruise_contract_mult）、该契约720天内已发布过则排除；目标是方舟周围1–5跳内有情报的系统。

Internal contract of the Forever Cruise origin (origin_forever_cruise) raised by the passenger side; it cannot be issued by the player (potential_issuer always = no). The yearly pulse nomads.1300 → nomads.1305 draws among the 30 cruise contracts (weight 10 each; x5 for the angry side, @cruise_contract_mult; excluded for 720 days after being issued) when fewer than 3 contracts are outstanding (5 when favouring a side) and the passenger-satisfaction progress is outside 450–550; the target is an intelligence-visible system 1–5 jumps from the arkship.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

接受后启用专项 CONTRACT_SUNTRIP_passenger_3_PROJECT（180天，需方舟 carries_colony=1，位于目标系）；项目成功使计数器 +1 完成。

On acceptance the special project CONTRACT_SUNTRIP_passenger_3_PROJECT (180 days, needs an arkship with carries_colony = 1, located at the target system) is enabled; project success raises the counter +1.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

完成：承包者（永恒巡航）得到贸易 2500（按 cruise_contract_bonus_value 放大，每完成一份 +25%），乘客满意度上升（increase_passenger_satisfaction），并登记一次巡航契约完成（nomads.3003）。 中途取消则乘客/船员满意度受罚（aborted_passenger_contract_effect，±20）。 契约被取消、超时或中止时（on_cancel / on_stop），发布者对承包者的好感下降（opinion_failed_contract_*），事件链与全部兴趣点标记被清除。

Completion: the cruise empire receives trade 2500 (scaled by cruise_contract_bonus_value, +25% per completed cruise contract), passenger satisfaction rises (increase_passenger_satisfaction) and a cruise contract completion is logged (nomads.3003). Cancelling penalises satisfaction (aborted_passenger_contract_effect, +/-20). If the contract is cancelled, times out or is aborted (on_cancel / on_stop), the issuer's opinion of the operator drops (opinion_failed_contract_*), and the chain and all points of interest are cleared.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

同一类型共有5个变体（1–5），只有标题、描述与图片不同，结构完全相同。乘客/船员两侧各5个，本卡为“乘客”侧。

There are five variants (1–5) of each type that differ only in title, description and picture; the structure is identical. Each side (passenger/crew) has five; this card is the "passenger" side.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

对照契约定义、内联脚本、专项与事件钩子核实了发布/接受条件、完成方式、奖励与失败处理；事件链卡片是模型中唯一的可读文档（任务、专项与钩子事件不是文档），因此本导读承载结构。

The issue/accept conditions, completion mechanism, rewards and failure handling were checked against the mission, inline scripts, special projects and hook events; the chain card is the only readable doc in the model (missions, projects and hook events are not docs), so this guide carries the structure.
